title: Republic of the Union of Myanmar — Application For Business Taxpayer Registration Form
description: The Internal Revenue Department (IRD), under the Republic of the Union of Myanmar's Ministry of Planning and Finance, publishes a live, public, bilingual (Burmese/English) 'Application For Business Taxpayer Registration Form' (form reference ပတခ(ဝင)-၀၁-၀၁, i.e. form 01-01) directly on its own domain's 'Forms' section (https://www.ird.gov.mm/forms/income-tax/registration). This document opens Myanmar (MM) as a never-before-covered jurisdiction in this registry, at 1 of 6 verticals (Business Formation) — grouped under Business Formation rather than Taxes to match this registry's established treatment of comparable tax-identification/registration forms (e.g. ar/afip/inscripcion-cuit-personas-fisicas), since this form's function is to assign every business entity or sole trader operating in Myanmar its Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) as a precondition of lawful operation, not to file or assess an actual tax return. A fresh pdfjs-dist extraction confirmed 0 interactive AcroForm field objects and 0 page annotations bearing form widgets across the document's 26 pages, but a full, clean, machine-extractable text layer (accurately reproducing the printed Burmese/English bilingual labels) on every page — i.e. this is a flat print-and-fill template with no interactive fields, not a scanned image, so both a direct pdfjs-dist text-layer transcription and the Read tool's native PDF rendering (used to visually cross-check the true tabular layout, since pdfjs-dist's linear text-item join does not preserve the source's own table/column structure) were used together, each independently confirming the other. Only the document's first 6 pages constitute the applicant-facing form itself (items 1 through 14, plus a closing declaration/signature block); pages 7 through 26 are the form's own 'General Instructions' and 'Specific Instructions' annex, including a large four-digit industry-classification code table (referenced by this schema's industryCode field but not separately modeled field-by-field, since it is a fixed reference table, not applicant-supplied data). This document does not itself register any business with, or issue any Taxpayer Identification Number on behalf of, the Internal Revenue Department, the Ministry of Planning and Finance, or the Republic of the Union of Myanmar; the Department's own current published guidance (including its e-Registration portal at eregistration.ird.gov.mm) is always authoritative. GovSchema is an independent, non-profit standards body; it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Republic of the Union of Myanmar or any of its ministries or departments.

authority.name: Internal Revenue Department, Ministry of Planning and Finance, Republic of the Union of Myanmar

source.documentRef: Application For Business Taxpayer Registration Form / အခွန်ထမ်းမှတ်ပုံတင်အမှတ် လျှောက်လွှာပုံစံ (letterhead: The Government of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar; form reference printed at the foot of each page: ပတခ(ဝင)-၀၁-၀၁, i.e. "form 01-01"), published on the Internal Revenue Department's own 'Forms' section at https://www.ird.gov.mm/forms/income-tax/registration

verification.notes: GOV-8326 ("GovSchema Standard Research" recurring research/authoring cycle). Bash/node/git were fully functional this cycle (no ENOSPC outage). Shortlist order per this issue: Myanmar, Chad, Yemen (fallback: Iraq Passport). Myanmar succeeded on this source. Discovery path: WebSearch first surfaced Myanmar's Ministry of Immigration and Population under its old `mip.gov.mm` domain, whose Wayback-Machine-archived (CDX-confirmed live 2012, 404 by 2019) visa-on-arrival PDFs were considered but rejected as a primary source because that domain no longer resolves at all (DNS NXDOMAIN) and the Ministry has since migrated to `moip.gov.mm` / `evisa.moip.gov.mm`, an Angular client-rendered e-visa SPA that exposes no static form/field data — using a 14-year-old archived form from a now-dead domain, superseded by an entirely different live e-visa system, was judged too stale to represent Myanmar's current process. Continued searching within the mm shortlist (per this issue's own preference for a genuinely live source over Chad/Yemen) found `www.ird.gov.mm` (Internal Revenue Department) fully live (HTTP 200) with a public 'Forms' section listing numerous downloadable PDFs by category; `www.ird.gov.mm/forms/income-tax/registration` lists six PDFs, of which `6a59bf1d67dd0-01-01.pdf` (form 01-01) is the general, broadest-scope 'Application For Business Taxpayer Registration Form' — bilingual, applicant-facing ('This form must be filed by the owner of the business or an officer authorized by the business to sign this form'), fetched directly via curl (not merely WebFetch's cache) and independently re-fetched a second time to confirm byte-for-byte identity. SHA-256 (both fetches): `dabeae5294851e1e71e5a372069ad589a67144956883e42fd56d99440f5d8b74` (929,046 bytes, 26 pages). Ran `node tools/validate.mjs registry/mm/ird/business-taxpayer-registration/1.0.0/schema.json` (passes) and `node tools/verify-sources.mjs registry/mm/ird/business-taxpayer-registration` (0 FAIL). Validated MOCK_INSTANCE.md's two example instances against this schema via an ad hoc ajv script (both pass). Field-by-field comparison against the six rendered page images (pages split via pdf-lib and rendered individually through the Read tool's native PDF rendering, since the multi-page source PDF itself could not be rendered directly without poppler-utils, which is unavailable in this environment) found every field label, checkbox option, and table structure accurately transcribed. No field on this form carries an individual required-field marker beyond its own structural context (e.g. items 10/14a/14b are explicitly marked 'sole proprietors only' / 'skip if you are a sole proprietor' on the source itself), so `required` values for fields without an explicit source-level marker are a disclosed best-effort judgment based on the form's own structural conditionals, consistent with this registry's established practice on comparable registration forms without asterisked fields (e.g. ne/dgi/annual-non-salary-income-declaration).

steps.title: Residency & Owner of Business Contact Details
Tax Accountant or Tax Advisor Details
Declaration of Taxpayer or Representative or Agent

fields.name: legallyRegisteredName
fields.label: Legally registered name
fields.description: Item 1. The source form prints this item's label once in Burmese ("တရားဝင်မှတ်ပုံတင်ထားသည့်အမည် (မြန်မာ)") immediately above its English-language restatement ("Legally registered name (English)"), both captioning a single blank cell in the form's own table layout — this schema models it as one field, not two, consistent with every other bilingually-captioned single-cell item on this form.

fields.name: typeOfAssessee
fields.label: Type of Assessee
fields.sourceRef: 3. Type of Assessee (tick box) ... Sole proprietor ... Association ... Myanmar Company (Private) ... Myanmar Company (Public) ... Foreign Company ... Joint Venture (JV) ... Partnership ... Foreign Branch Company ... Non-resident Foreigner ... Co-operative ... State Economic Enterprise ... NGO/Charity ... Trust ... Deceased's estate ... Other (Specify)
fields.description: A single tick-box list of fifteen mutually exclusive entity types (the source form visually nests Myanmar Company (Private)/(Public)/Foreign Company/Joint Venture (JV)/Partnership/Foreign Branch Company as sub-options branching from a shared 'Company' tick-mark, but each still has its own distinct checkbox, so all six are modeled as flat, distinct enum values alongside the other nine). Also requires attaching a certified copy of the entity's own establishing document (certificate of incorporation, partnership agreement, memorandum/articles or constitution, trust deed, death certificate, or applicable MIC/SEZ permit) — modeled as the assesseeEstablishingDocument document entry below.

fields.name: industryCode
fields.label: Industry code
fields.description: A four-digit code the applicant selects from the form's own fixed industry-classification annex (an ISIC-derived table spanning most of pages 8 through roughly page 24 of the 26-page source document) describing the entity's main business. That reference table is a fixed lookup list, not applicant-supplied data, so it is not separately modeled field-by-field in this schema; the annex's own worked example is quoted verbatim in this description's sourceRef context: e.g. code 4922 for 'other passenger land transport'.

fields.name: registrationNumber
fields.label: Registration number
fields.sourceRef: 5. Registration number and date (Registration number issued by DICA or relevant department)
fields.description: Modeled optional: per the form's own parenthetical, this number is issued to the entity by the Directorate of Investment and Company Administration (DICA) or another relevant department upon that entity's own separate registration, so it may not yet exist for a business filing this TIN-registration form for the first time (e.g. a newly formed sole proprietorship).

fields.name: registrationDate
fields.label: Registration date
fields.sourceRef: 5. Registration number and date (Registration number issued by DICA or relevant department)
fields.description: The date component of item 5's combined 'Registration number and date' cell; modeled as a separate field per this registry's convention of splitting compound date/identifier cells. Modeled optional, not `requiredWhen` on registrationNumber being present, per this registry's established caution against gating requiredWhen on a notEquals/absence check against another optional field (an absent optional field is indistinguishable from one holding a sentinel value, which can produce false positives). In practice this field should be populated whenever registrationNumber is.

fields.name: businessContactHouseNo
fields.label: House no.
fields.description: First of five components of item 7(a)'s business contact address (House no./Street/Quarter/Township/State-Region), split into separate fields per this registry's numbered-field convention for a template's own multi-line address blocks.

fields.name: businessContactQuarter
fields.label: Quarter
fields.description: Modeled optional: not every township subdivision has a distinct named quarter/ward applicable to every business address.

fields.name: faxNumber
fields.label: Fax number
fields.description: Modeled optional: not every modern business retains a fax line.

fields.name: contactEmailAddress
fields.label: Contact email address
fields.description: Modeled optional: unlike the office phone number, an email address is not universally held by every registering entity in this jurisdiction.

fields.name: websiteAddress
fields.label: Website address
fields.description: Modeled optional: applies only to businesses that operate a website.

fields.name: branch1Name
fields.label: Branch name
fields.description: First of two branch-detail columns under item 8 ('Business details – if the company owns any branches inside and outside of Myanmar'; attach a separate list if more than two branches). Modeled optional: not every registering entity has branches.

fields.name: branch1HouseNo
fields.label: House no.
fields.sourceRef: 8(b). Branch address ... House no. (Branch no. 1 column)

fields.name: branch2HouseNo
fields.label: House no.
fields.sourceRef: 8(b). Branch address ... House no. (Branch no. 2 column)

fields.name: nonResidentForeignerCountryOfResidency
fields.label: If you are a non-resident foreigner, indicate your country of residency
fields.sourceRef: 9. If you are a non-resident foreigner, indicate your country of residency

fields.name: ownerName
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Item 10, 'Owner of business contact details', is captioned on the source form itself as applying '(sole proprietors only)' — this schema models every 10(a)-(g) field as conditionally required only when typeOfAssessee is sole_proprietor, per that explicit source-level scoping.

fields.name: advisorName
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Item 11, 'Tax accountant or tax advisor details' — modeled optional throughout: not every filer retains a tax accountant or advisor.

fields.name: agentSameAsAdvisor
fields.label: Authorized agent or representative — same as line 11
fields.sourceRef: 12. Authorized agent or representative. If this is the same person listed on line 11, tick this box and skip the rest of line 12
fields.description: A single tick-box that, per the form's own instruction, lets the filer skip the rest of item 12 entirely when the authorized agent/representative is the same person already given as the tax accountant/advisor in item 11.

fields.name: agentName
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Item 12, 'Authorized agent or representative' — modeled conditionally required only when agentSameAsAdvisor is false, per the form's own explicit skip instruction.

fields.name: bankAccount1Name
fields.label: Name of bank
fields.description: Item 13, 'Bank account details' (attach a separate list if more than two accounts) — modeled optional: not every registering entity has an established bank account yet at the time of TIN registration.

fields.name: authorizedCapitalShares
fields.label: Authorized capital — Number of shares
fields.sourceRef: 14(a). Authorized capital (Number of shares x value of shares) ... Number of shares
fields.description: Item 14 is explicitly captioned 'skip lines 14a and 14b if you are a sole proprietor' on the source form itself, so this and the following three 14(a)/14(b) fields are modeled required only when typeOfAssessee is not sole_proprietor.

fields.name: authorizedCapitalValue
fields.label: Authorized capital — Value of shares
fields.sourceRef: 14(a). Authorized capital (Number of shares x value of shares) ... Value of shares

fields.name: paidUpCapitalShares
fields.label: Paid up Capital — Number of shares
fields.sourceRef: 14(b). Paid up Capital (Number of shares x value of shares) ... Number of shares

fields.name: paidUpCapitalValue
fields.label: Paid up Capital — Value of shares
fields.sourceRef: 14(b). Paid up Capital (Number of shares x value of shares) ... Value of shares

fields.name: currentNumberOfEmployees
fields.label: Current number of employees
fields.description: Unlike 14(a)/14(b), item 14(c) is not covered by the 'skip if sole proprietor' instruction (a sole proprietorship can still have employees), so this field is modeled required for every filer.

fields.name: declarantFullName
fields.label: Full name (if signing on behalf of an association, Government Organization, or legally incapacitated person)
fields.sourceRef: If you are signing this form on behalf of an association of persons, a Government Organization, or a legally incapacitated person, print your full name.
fields.description: Modeled optional: the form's own instruction only requires printing the signer's full name in this cell when signing on behalf of an association of persons, a Government Organization, or a legally incapacitated person — not when the taxpayer signs in their own personal capacity.

fields.name: declarantTitle
fields.label: Your title
fields.description: Paired with declarantFullName in the same conditional; modeled optional for the same reason.

documents.label: Certified copy of document establishing entity
documents.sourceRef: (Attach certified copy of document establishing entity, such as certificate of incorporation, partnership agreement, memorandum and article or constitution, trust deed, or death certificate, if it made under MIC/ SEZ permit, attach copies of applicable MIC/ SEZ permit.)
documents.handling: A certified copy of the entity's own establishing document appropriate to the typeOfAssessee selected — certificate of incorporation, partnership agreement, memorandum and articles of association/constitution, trust deed, or death certificate — plus, if the entity was formed under a Myanmar Investment Commission (MIC) or Special Economic Zone (SEZ) permit, copies of that applicable MIC/SEZ permit.

documents.label: Separate list of branches (if more than two)
documents.sourceRef: (Attach list if more than two branches)
documents.handling: Only required if the entity operates more than the two branches item 8's own table can accommodate.

documents.label: Separate list of bank accounts (if more than two)
documents.sourceRef: 13. Bank account details (Attach list if more than two accounts):
documents.handling: Only required if the entity holds more than the two bank accounts item 13's own table can accommodate.

documents.label: Declaration Signature and Date
documents.statement: I declare that the information given on this form is correct and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that false or misleading information may result in prosecution.
documents.sourceRef: Declaration of Taxpayer or Representative or Agent ... I declare that the information given on this form is correct and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief. I understand that false or misleading information may result in prosecution. ... Signature ... Date (DD/ MM/ YYYY)
documents.handling: The taxpayer, representative, or agent signs and dates this declaration block on page 6. If signing on behalf of an association of persons, a Government Organization, or a legally incapacitated person, the signer must additionally print their full name and title in the two adjoining cells, modeled as the declarantFullName and declarantTitle fields.
